title: CHS FISHING Capt Shane Sinclair
specs: Charleston is a year-round fishing paradise with abundant redfish, trout, flounder, and seasonal migratory species.
Captain Shane Sinclair has over 30 years fishing experience and 20 years guiding in Charleston waters.

blurb: Guests fish in Charleston's salt marshes, flats, and oyster beds targeting species like redfish, trout, flounder, and seasonal migratory fish. Charters include inshore fly fishing and light tackle, as well as nearshore and offshore trips for species such as wahoo, mahi, cobia, snapper, grouper, tarpon, and sharks.
